limits: Source-bound pre-repair min4 sampler, seed17. Both channel-specific majority variants execute on all demonstrations before any of their query tests. Blue-only majority fits all4 demonstrations and differs at query2; no training admission or owner acceptance is claimed.

programs.blue_majority_four:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (define (kind o)
    (if (>= (count-if (lambda (p) (= (first p) (obj-r1 o))) (obj-cells o)) 3) 0 1))
  (let* ((os (objects g 0))
           (a (count-if (lambda (o) (= (kind o) 0)) os))
           (b (count-if (lambda (o) (= (kind o) 1)) os))
           (pa a) (pb b) (paired (min pa pb))
           (ra (- pa paired)) (rb (- pb paired))
           (aout (min 4 (if (> ra rb) 4 0))) (bout (min 4 rb))
           (blue (take (list (list 0 3) (list 2 3) (list 0 5) (list 2 5)) aout))
           (green (take (list (list 0 0) (list 2 0) (list 0 2) (list 2 2)) bout)))
    (grid-from-fn 3 6 (lambda (r c)
      (cond ((member (list r c) blue) 1)
            ((member (list r c) green) 3)
            (else 0)))))))
programs.cancel_opposites:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((os (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0)))
         (a (count-if (lambda (o)
              (>= (count-if (lambda (p) (= (first p) (obj-r1 o))) (obj-cells o)) 3)) os))
         (b (- (length os) a))
         (pre-a a) (pre-b b)
         (matched (min pre-a pre-b))
         (left-a (- pre-a matched)) (left-b (- pre-b matched))
         (green (take (list (list 0 0) (list 2 0) (list 0 2) (list 2 2)) (min left-b 4)))
         (blue (take (list (list 0 3) (list 2 3) (list 0 5) (list 2 5)) (min left-a 4))))
    (grid-from-fn 3 6 (lambda (r c)
      (cond ((member (list r c) green) 3)
            ((member (list r c) blue) 1)
            (else 0)))))))
